build_transformer_text_encoder: build a TransformerTextEncoder with arch L12_W512_A8 vocab 49408 and context length 77
create_transformer_block: create a _TransformerBlock with d_model 512 and n_head 8 for self-attention and MLP
encode_text_tokens: encode tokenized text sequences through the TransformerTextEncoder forward pass to get textual features
enable_grad_checkpointing: enable gradient checkpointing on TransformerTextEncoder to reduce memory during training
parse_architecture_string: parse an architecture string like L12_W512_A8 to extract layers width and attention heads
